notes: Route: robots.txt (HTTP 200, fetched) is permissive - only /buscar and /preview/ disallowed, so sitemaps are open. /sitemap.xml (HTTP 200) is a sitemap index listing per-month article sitemaps /sitemaps/articles/YYYY-MM.xml; fetched 2026-09.xml (200, 1772 URLs) and 2026-10.xml (200, 1535 URLs), both flat urlsets with <loc> + <lastmod>. Article permalinks embed the publication date in the path (/section/YYYY/M/D/slug-ID.html), so the script takes the date from the URL, not lastmod: lastmod is edit time (e.g. a 2026-09-30 article carried lastmod 2026-10-01T00:10Z). URL date verified against the page's JSON-LD datePublished: 4/4 sampled articles (one each from 09-30, 10-10, 10-20, 10-25) have datePublished on the exact listed date, HTTP 200, body text 6062-11837 chars (>1500). Monthly files also contain re-edited older articles (2026-09.xml includes /2026/8/31/ URLs), so the script filters strictly on URL dates inside 2026-09-25..2026-10-25. Result: 1877 unique URLs, 31/31 days, per-day 36-82 (check days: 09-30=66, 10-10=39, 10-20=65), 0 out-of-window, 0 duplicates. Only 2 sitemap requests needed; no fallback route required. Script prints per-day counts and exits in seconds (sitemaps served from cache after first fetch).
